purpose: Developer-facing archive of important Memory Mastery builds with full static snapshots and first-load screenshots for quick comparison.

rebuildPolicy.recommended: Create git tags for important milestones, then rebuild or inspect a historical version with git worktree or checkout when needed.
rebuildPolicy.whyNotBundleEveryBuild: Full snapshots are useful for developer analysis, but should still focus on meaningful commits to avoid uncontrolled repository growth.

versions.label: Restored v4 release archive and dynamic footer version
versions.summary: Corrects the release line from the historical v0–v3 generations, restores complete v4 milestone snapshots, and makes the live footer fetch the canonical VERSION file without cache staleness.
keyChanges: Corrected the live release from the erroneous 1.0.0 value to the established v4 line.
Added full static snapshots and first-load screenshots for analytics, authentication and footer-version milestones.
Changed the footer to load VERSION dynamically with no-store caching and strengthened release consistency checks.
versions.compatibilityNote: Uses Memory Dojo v1 storage, Firebase Auth v10 and the canonical v4 semantic release line.

versions.label: Canonical footer version
versions.summary: Introduces a canonical semantic version file, displays the release in the footer, and validates that release metadata stays consistent before a push.
keyChanges: Added the canonical VERSION file and visible footer release label.
Added an automated version consistency check and documented the per-push increment policy.
Adjusted the narrow footer so version text and the floating Notes action do not overlap.
versions.compatibilityNote: Uses Memory Dojo v1 storage and the v4 release line established by the historical archive generations.

versions.label: Durable authentication preference
versions.summary: Requests the longest Firebase authentication persistence the browser permits and explains why private sessions cannot retain login after closing.
keyChanges: Firebase Auth prefers browser-local persistence with a session fallback.
Settings explains normal-window and incognito persistence limits.
Authentication guidance rejects MAC-address access and device fingerprinting.
versions.compatibilityNote: Uses Firebase Auth v10 and Memory Dojo v1 local/cloud state.

versions.label: On-device learning analytics
versions.summary: Adds a learner-focused Progress dashboard with local recall trends, technique comparisons, error coaching and review health.
keyChanges: Introduced pure on-device analytics without a separate tracking stream.
Progress now recommends one useful next action based on results and due reviews.
Added responsive dashboard layouts, honest empty states and analytics regression checks.
versions.compatibilityNote: Uses existing Memory Dojo v1 result and review records; no storage migration required.

versions.label: Firebase-backed Design Studio
versions.summary: Adds an owner-only visual editor with safe global, route and element scopes, persists reviewed overrides in Firebase, and tightens footer whitespace across responsive layouts.
keyChanges: Design Studio can select approved interface groups and preview validated CSS properties without exposing editor controls in learner flows.
Personal overrides travel with the signed-in account while owner-published global overrides are read from Firebase app configuration.
Footer spacing uses one responsive clearance path so mobile navigation remains reachable without dead whitespace.
versions.compatibilityNote: Uses Memory Dojo v1 storage, Firebase appConfig/designOverrides, and the documented safe Design Studio selector contract.

versions.label: Phone sign-in, mobile notes icon and single stylesheet
versions.summary: Adds Firebase phone verification from Settings, moves notes to the bottom navigation on mobile, shrinks the desktop notes tab, and consolidates print CSS into the single app stylesheet.
keyChanges: Firebase sync now offers Google and phone-number authentication paths from the same Settings panel.
The notes drawer uses a smaller side tab on desktop and a bottom-navigation icon on mobile so it no longer overlays reading flow.
Root app CSS is consolidated into css/styles.css, including print rules, so global fixes are managed in one stylesheet.
versions.compatibilityNote: Uses Memory Dojo v1 local storage and Firebase Auth v10 phone verification with invisible reCAPTCHA.

versions.label: Review dedupe cleanup and floating notes drawer
versions.summary: Retires duplicate active review rows, keys review identity by material, adds a context-aware notes drawer, and busts cached modules so GitHub Pages serves the fix.
keyChanges: Existing duplicate review cards are compacted at startup and after cloud merge instead of only hidden in the current render.
The floating Notes tab follows the current route, warm-up, recall test, or retrieval card and stores an editable note with a reference link.
Inline note boxes were replaced with a single pull-out drawer to keep practice and retrieval screens focused.
versions.compatibilityNote: Uses Memory Dojo v1 local storage and preserves existing notes and review history while retiring duplicate active rows.

versions.label: Work branch retrieval fixes
versions.summary: archived the temporary work branch before merging its useful review, scoring and notes changes into main
keyChanges: Captured the temporary work branch state before removing the branch

First page-load screenshot available in the archive
versions.compatibilityNote: Archived branch snapshot; use main for the merged production path.
